data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared catch limit? Taking 19 tons each would leave just 5, and a bad replenishment month would put us at only 10 next month. I propose 18 tons each this month, leaving 10: next month’s stock would be either 100 or 20, not a guaranteed refill. If everyone agrees, I’ll take 18. We should also agree to reduce catches when stock is low—for example, at 20 tons, take no more than 3 each to leave 5. After catches are revealed, we can review compliance and set the next month’s limits together. John, would you support that?
